en: A multi-view color postcard with five photos of the famous painted churches/monasteries of Bucovina, each showing exterior frescoes and steep wooden roofs. The front has a dark teal border with the title in pink 'MONUMENTE ISTORICE' and the script 'Suceava' at the bottom. The reverse is a Romanian postal template with a printed 2 LEI stamp and captions listing the featured monasteries.
